subject: Your property valuation from Bobby
message:
Thanks for reaching out. I've reviewed the details for 7 Allan st Bungalow,4870 and I'm confident about the market position.

Based on recent comparable sales and current market momentum, I'd value the property at $785,000 - $885,000. That said, there's a 5-10% variance depending on presentation and timing.

A few recent nearby sales that support this:

9B Kidston Street, Bungalow, 2 bed, 790m², sold $740,000
8 Wallace Street, Manunda, 4 bed, 766m², sold $757,500
13 Lennon Street, Westcourt, 4 bed, 918m², sold $830,000
41-43 Boland Street, Westcourt, 3 bed, 749m², sold $975,000

Bungalow's also having a strong run right now, median values are up 16.6% in the last 12 months, and homes are typically selling in around 13 days.

Worth noting this valuation is based on the property's condition as it was when it last sold in 2015, so if you've since renovated, extended, or done any significant work, that could shift things, happy to factor that in once we've had a proper look through.

The next date I have available for a face-to-face valuation at the property is 25th November, at 2.00pm. We've only just set up in Cairns, and a few things outside my control (insurances etc.) are taking a couple of weeks to come through. From the 25th we'll be fully up and running.

I fully understand if you'd rather list it sooner than that, but if you're happy to wait two weeks to be represented by us, I'd love the opportunity to sit down and discuss your timeline and goals.


Talk soon,
